description: Page your conversations with the O++ assistant, across supported clients. A conversation whose private source access changed returns only safe locked metadata. Person only.

regex.description: Filter conversations by regex on title. Needs sign-in. No lookaround, backreferences or \p; \w \d \s \b are ASCII. Case-insensitive, ^ $ per line, . stops at newlines: (?-i) (?-m) (?s) at the start change that. At most 256 characters and 62 positions: one per character, class or anchor, counting each alternative and repeated copy, so .* not .{0,100}. limit counts rows read; an empty page with has_more true means keep paging.

name: conversation_list
title: List your assistant conversations
